messages:
Marta: Quick ask for the Serving Wins launch next Wed 1: compact deliverables: hero slide (1920x1080), benchmark card (shareable PNG + SVG), slide master, 3 socials (1:1, 9:16, 16:9), email header, and a one-page SDR PDF. Need Figma link + CSV for chart. Deadline: Tue noon for first pass. @Diego @Priya
Diego: on it. Do we want competitor points shown or anonymized clusters?
Marta: anonymized clusters, callout for 'Recommended config' only. CSV in analytics, I'll grant access.
Priya: brand quicks: use Redwood Blue for primary, no gradients on charts, stacked logo on hero, horizontal in footer. I'll add swatches in Figma.
Kei: hero headline option: "Serve smarter 1 faster, cheaper inference." Use that on hero.
Amir: UTMs: utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=serving_wins_launch. HubSpot mapping: hs_source="Webinar: Serving Wins", hs_campaign="serving_wins_launch", hs_tags="webinar_servingwins". I'll prep form.
LegalBot: Requesting data provenance CSV and API run IDs before approving claims.
Diego: ETA for first comps: Mon 6pm. I'll include alt text in Figma and export PNG (2x) + SVG.
Marta: great, ping when up. Thanks!
notes: Short kickoff for compact launch assets and routing; includes UTMs and legal check.
